l2_04_01_transform_2026_10_26.commands: 28 verified command bodies: Scale 3D, Scale 2D, Scale 1D, Scale Non-Uniform, Scale By Plane, Orient 2 Points, Orient 3 Points, Orient on Surface, Orient on Curve, Orient Perpendicular to Curve, Symmetry, Bend, Taper, Twist, Shear, Maelstrom, Soft Move, Rotate 3D, Array Polar, Array Linear, Array, Array Along Curve, Array Along Surface, Array Curve on Surface, Stretch, Set Points, Project To C-Plane, Remap to C-Plane
open_scope: OM9-L3-04-01-019 Solid Points ON: its contract needs editable subobject grips; the selection model is object-level
OM9-L3-04-01-037 Make Down Facing: L4-01 records unresolved_owner_policy BLOCKED_OWNER ("design minimal owner extension without enabling button")
the Smart Flow rows record a live link but not a history node: a change of the target surface is recomputed by re-running the row, and M08 owns automatic recompute (OM9-L3-04-05-004)
M03-UI review of the 39 enabled rows is unsigned (manual gate)
l2_04_01_transform_2026_10_26.authored_key_parity: Every catalog row carries command_key, the authored MainMenu.ini/icons.rs identifier; one mis-bound icon was fixed and two rows without authored artwork are pinned by the test.

curve_rows.selection_rule: a curve row takes its path from the selection: exactly one selected curve is the path and every other selected object is transformed along it, because the shell has no mid-command object pick
curve_rows.snapping: Shared closest_point_on_curve; analytic line projection, bounded numeric search for other curves.
curve_rows.spacing: measured arc length via curve_ops::arc_length and length_between

l2_04_01_transform_2026_10_26.per_object_commit_fix: commit_transform_mutations applies one step per object when a row hands in one step per target, so Project To C-Plane drops objects from different heights onto the plane instead of applying the first object's distance to all of them

reference_rows.selection_rule: a reference row takes its frame from the selection: exactly one surface (or one path curve) plus the objects to transform, because the shell has no mid-command object pick
reference_rows.switches: the reference rows ask their switches as 0/1 numbers because the typed contract of the module is points and scalars; check_number indexes the scalar, not the field
reference_rows.mirror: Symmetry commits an affine reflection of the placement, so every geometry kind mirrors without a geometry-specific mirror routine

deformer_rows.deforms: Bend, Taper, Twist, Shear, Maelstrom, SoftMove
deformer_rows.space: a deform runs in world space and the result is written back into the object's own frame (top11::bake_geometry + top11::inverse_affine), so one Geometry mutation is one Undo entry and the placement is untouched
deformer_rows.sampling: a nonlinear map turns a straight segment into a curve, so a curve is written as a polycurve of 17 mapped samples; a shear is affine and keeps the line
deformer_rows.solid: a solid is refused with Error::Unsupported("deformation of a solid"): a B-Rep needs a kernel deformer and a display-mesh deformation would misreport the solid

flow_rows.source_frame: the flow rows take both frames from the selection and name the source by a picked point, because the selection is a set and has no pick order
flow_rows.rigid: the flow carries sections rigidly with the frame; it does not stretch geometry along the path and it has no twist control

surface_edit_rows.frame: the U tangent, the V tangent and the normal at each pole's Greville parameter, frozen before the edit
surface_edit_rows.selection: the row edits surfaces only and refuses any other selected object

cage_rows.model: a cage is a mesh box object with the corners it was created with in its om9.cage extension; a caged object carries the back pointer to that cage
cage_rows.field: a point keeps its parameter in the cage before the edit (Cage::invert) and lands on the same parameter after it, so one corner move is one exact trilinear displacement

smart_flow_rows.link: the om9.flow extension records base, target, rigid flag, revision and the ACTIVE/BROKEN state; Break keeps the geometry, and running a flow row again re-activates the link at the next revision
